stem.text: The diagram shows two vessels, P and Q, both with sides inclined at $45^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.

stem.alt: Diagram of two vessels labelled vessel P and vessel Q, with sides inclined to a horizontal line. Vessel P is wider at the top and vessel Q is narrower at the top, and each contains a shaded liquid.

stem.text: Vessel P tapers outwards and vessel Q tapers inwards, as shown.
Both vessels contain a liquid. The depth of the liquid in the vessels is the same. The liquid in vessel P is twice as dense as the liquid in vessel Q.
What is the ratio $\dfrac{\text{pressure due to the liquid on the base of P}}{\text{pressure due to the liquid on the base of Q}}$?
